headline: Currency rates in Ukraine for the week: what to expect from the dollar and euro in October
summary: The currency market in Ukraine continues to see heightened pressure on the hryvnia. The key factor for the coming week will remain the policy of the National Bank of Ukraine.
why: The hryvnia's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and the value of dollar- and euro-denominated assets for investors in Ukraine.
